import json
from graphify.build import build_from_json
from graphify.export import to_json
from networkx.readwrite import json_graph
from pathlib import Path

existing_data = json.loads\(Path\('graphify-out/graph.json'\).read_text\(encoding='utf-8'\)\)
G_existing = json_graph.node_link_graph\(existing_data, edges='links'\)
print\(f'Existing: {G_existing.number_of_nodes\(\)} nodes, {G_existing.number_of_edges\(\)} edges'\)

new_extraction = json.loads\(Path\('graphify-out/.graphify_ast.json'\).read_text\(encoding='utf-8'\)\)
G_new = build_from_json\(new_extraction\)

incremental = json.loads\(Path\('graphify-out/.graphify_incremental.json'\).read_text\(encoding='utf-8'\)\)
deleted = set\(incremental.get\('deleted_files', []\)\)
if deleted:
    to_remove = [n for n, d in G_existing.nodes\(data=True\) if d.get\('source_file'\) in deleted]
    G_existing.remove_nodes_from\(to_remove\)
    if to_remove:
        print\(f'Pruned {len\(to_remove\)} ghost nodes'\)

G_existing.update\(G_new\)
print\(f'Merged: {G_existing.number_of_nodes\(\)} nodes, {G_existing.number_of_edges\(\)} edges'\)

to_json\(G_existing, communities={}, out_path='graphify-out/graph.json', force=True\)

from graphify.detect import save_manifest
save_manifest\(incremental['files']\)
print\('Done'\)
" 2>&1)
